title: Width Bound for Split Clauses
statement: For every clause $C$ over natural-number variables and every cursor $n\in\mathbb{N}$, every clause in the formula obtained by splitting $C$ at $n$ has at most three literals.
replaced:
For every clause $C$ and cursor $n$, every clause of the formula obtained by
splitting $C$ at $n$ has at most three literals.
